B0: Using the question and ALL supplied source evidence (including distractors), generate the requested answer table. Return one JSON object {"columns":["entity", "attribute", ...], "rows":[["entity name","value",...],...]}. All cells strings, no pipes or line breaks. Entity must be first column. Include only answers supported by supplied evidence, preserving conditions; do not invent missing facts. No Markdown fences.
B1_plan_question_only: Translate only the question into {"predicates":["canonical predicate",...],"sql":"SELECT ..."}. This is a generic query plan, not an answer. Relation facts(subject,predicate,object,subject_key,predicate_key,object_key,evidence_id,numeric_value). Keys are NFKC-casefold-whitespace-normalized. Use subject_key for entity joins; object_key for filters. Preserve all query conditions. Request necessary predicates in predicates. Use a read-only SQLite SELECT with entity first and requested attributes as remaining columns. Use DISTINCT/grouping where appropriate; no extra relations. Never embed an answer entity list.
B1_per_source_extraction: Extract ALL relevant subject-predicate-object candidates from this single evidence unit using the supplied query predicates, including possible non-answer entities. Return {"facts":[{"subject":"name","predicate":"canonical predicate","object":"value","quote":"verbatim contiguous source substring"}]}. Preserve uncertainty and conditional qualifications in values; never invent cross-source links. Empty list allowed. Quote is a literal locator, not proof of semantic correctness.
